description: Shallow landslide inventory for 2000-2019 (eastern DRC, Rwanda, Burundi) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This shapefile contains 7944 shallow landslide instances for the North Tanganyika-Kivu Rift Region. These landslides were identified in © Google Earth. Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda, Burundi. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are shallow landslides, landslides. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
